name: coder-gate-v1
description: MLLM Coder v1 (relay/runs/2026-09-14T16-14-10-757Z/deliverable.md). The governed unit is one diff against one pre-named file/hunk, not prose. The `propose` seat is external: THCMCP never writes code itself, it hands the change-request task file to an outside coding session and gets one fenced diff back (docs/coder-gate-diff-format.md). The `builder` seat is also external, held to the same session, and must return the proposal's diff verbatim as this chain's draft - there is no second, independent code-writing step; `builder` exists only because every chain needs one to reach a draft, not because a second author writes anything. `verify` (config.verify) runs the named test command via the existing run_tests tool and injects the real pass/fail output as ground truth before the critic panel ever sees the diff. No write-capable tool is used anywhere - applying the diff to a real working tree stays a human/external action. Built entirely from existing stage types (proposal, debate, critic, unanimous signoff); no change to src/chain.js or src/tools.js.
